title: Wombats in space!
description: This project adds many mods that have to do with space exploration and some other fun stuff. Sadly there are no wombats ):
body:
This modpack adds many mods about space exploration that aim to make the world of minecraft much more vast adding new planets, star systems, structures, biomes, and laptops the create mod and a sound mod cause I felt like it!


Make sure to check out my other [mods](https://modrinth.com/user/TheCombatWombat)
